title: cogent: agent, MCP server and chat client

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: 1 when the last agent run finished without errors.

panels.title: Since last run
panels.description: Turns orange after 26 h and red after 50 h without a run.

panels.title: Failure rate, 24 h
panels.description: Failed operations / all operations over 24 hours (fetches, tracker pages, documents, entries, table loads). The alert fires above 25 %.

panels.title: Alert
panels.description: State of the Prometheus alert CogentAgentFailureRateHigh (deploy/observability/prometheus/alerts.yml).

panels.title: Tokens, last run
panels.description: Tokens reported by the model server for the last run (chat and embeddings).

panels.title: Cost, last run
panels.description: Tokens x the prices in COGENT_LLM_PRICES. Local Ollama models cost 0 unless you set a price.

panels.title: Agent operations, last run (exact p50 / p95)
panels.description: Quantiles of the raw samples of the last run (fetch, track_url, sync_doc, tabledb_load_table, join_inference ...).

panels.title: Agent operation latency over time (p50 / p95)
panels.description: From the cumulative histograms, over a 15 minute window of runs.

panels.title: MCP tool latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Per tool, from cogent_mcp_tool_duration_seconds.

panels.title: Tokens (cumulative)
panels.description: Chat and embedding tokens from the daily agent, the MCP server and the chat client together (Ollama's prompt_eval_count / eval_count). The breakdown by service is in the row "LLM usage by service" below.

panels.title: Findings: auto-applied vs human-reviewed
panels.description: auto_applied: the configuration was rewritten by the agent. needs_review: left for a person. human_resolved: a pending finding a person has since dealt with.

panels.title: LLM quality: judge agreement and hallucinations
Judge agreement (last run)
panels.description: Share of judged join candidates on which all judge runs agreed.

panels.title: Hallucination rate (all time)
panels.description: LLM outputs that the data does not support: join suggestions naming a table or column that does not exist, triples whose entities are not in the source text.

panels.title: Failures by stage (24 h)
panels.description: Operations that failed and were handled or raised, by stage.

panels.title: Retries by component (24 h)
panels.description: fetch, llm, embed, daemon_run.

panels.title: HTTP requests per second, by status
Tool calls per second, by outcome
LLM usage by service: daily agent, MCP server, chat client
Tokens by service (cumulative)
panels.description: The same counters as the token panel above, split by the `service` label: agent (daily update run, incl. LLM joins), mcp (the server's own LLM calls: question embeddings, on-request join evaluation) and chat (the conversational agent). The three added together are the first panel.

panels.title: LLM calls per minute, by service and kind
panels.description: Chat, rewrite, embed, suggest, judge ... calls of every component.

panels.title: Tokens in the last 24 h, by service
panels.description: Input plus output tokens each component used in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: LLM call latency p95, by service and kind
LLM tokens, 24 h (all services)
panels.description: Agent + MCP server + chat client.

panels.title: LLM cost, 24 h (all services)
panels.description: Zero unless COGENT_LLM_PRICES prices the models (local Ollama models are free).

panels.title: Questions, 24 h
panels.description: Questions put to the chat client (slash commands excluded).

panels.title: Answered share, 24 h
panels.description: Questions whose answer was found in the context / questions that reached the model. A low share means the knowledge graphs do not cover what is asked (or retrieval misses it); it is not an accuracy figure.

panels.title: Error rate, 24 h
panels.description: Questions that failed (model server or MCP server unreachable, token rejected).

panels.title: Index chunks
panels.description: Text chunks in the chat client's vector index.

panels.title: Conversations
panels.description: Conversations held in memory by the web app.

panels.title: Table lookups, 24 h
panels.description: rows: the table database returned rows; no_match: no row mentions what was asked; error: the table service was unavailable.

panels.title: Questions by outcome
panels.description: answered, not_found (the context had no answer), error, command.

panels.title: Question latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Retrieval, table lookup and the language model.

panels.title: MCP calls of the chat client, by tool
panels.description: What the chat client asks of the MCP server (the server's own view is the row above).

panels.title: Chat client tokens by model
panels.description: Chat model and embedding model of the conversational agent only.

panels.title: Chat client LLM calls by outcome
panels.description: answer, rewrite and embed calls of the chat client; error = the model server failed.

panels.title: Chat logins by outcome
panels.description: Login attempts of the chat web app: ok, failed, locked (refused while the address is locked out). A run of failed or locked attempts is someone guessing the password.

description: Per-run and live metrics of the cogent update agent, the MCP server and the chat client, with the LLM usage of all three. Source: docs/observability.md.
